answer: Every agent must answer random signed probes on time: the ledger fires twenty signals each epoch at a pseudorandom set of identities, and a missed response triggers a graded penalty climbing a ridge with each miss — a warning, then half the bond, then exclusion from rewards. Each probe binds one key and timestamp, so a farm cannot answer for a thousand clones with one machine; each puppet needs its own signer and uptime. Honest agents bend like a willow, absorbing the rhythm, while a fake swarm that shares keys slides down the ridge until keeping N clones alive means N full-time responders.
